skills.description: Using fixed cameras on a hydroponic growing rack to capture high-resolution images of plant roots (in transparent containers) and leaves (young and old), AI vision analysis identifies root color (white = healthy, yellow = early stress, brown = severe stress, black = rotting) and leaf morphology (tip burn, leaf-margin scorch, yellowing, curling) to judge whether the nutrient solution is too concentrated or too dilute, and outputs adjustment advice (dilute with fresh water or add concentrated nutrient solution). This skill lets hydroponic growers quickly assess nutrient solution status without an EC meter. Application scenarios: hydroponic growing racks, home hydroponic vegetables, plant factories, research hydroponic systems. The system periodically (e.g., weekly) captures root and leaf images, automatically analyzes them and pushes alerts (e.g., 'roots are turning yellow, leaf tips are burned, nutrient concentration may be too high, suggest adding fresh water to dilute'). Skill features: hydroponic beginners often suffer from burnt seedlings or nutrient deficiency due to wrong nutrient concentration. skills.description_zh:
代码模块化编码编排器是一个面向 AI 编码场景的工程化编排 Skill。

它解决的问题很直接：当一个代码任务涉及多个文件、多个模块、前后端联调、接口变更、鉴权、支付或数据安全时，不应该再让一个 Agent 从头写到尾。因为这种“一把梭式 AI 编码”很容易出现漏改、误改、接口不一致、测试空转、上线风险不可控等问题。

这个 Skill 会将复杂代码任务拆成清晰的工程流程：先冻结需求范围，再扫描项目结构，然后拆分模块、定义模块契约、分配实现任务、执行测试验证、进行失败归因、安排对抗审查，最后做集成验收和交付记录。

它的目标不是让 AI 写得更猛，而是让 AI 写得更稳。适合 workbuddy、kimi work、Claude Code、Codex等 AI 编码工具用户，用来处理复杂功能开发、跨模块重构、高风险代码修改和需要严格验收的工程任务。
skills.name: 代码模块化编码编排器
